blocks.heading: How we work
blocks.body:
One team stays with a project from the first call to launch.
No hand-offs, no account managers.

blocks.heading: What you can count on
blocks.intro: No account managers and no hand-offs. The person who draws your mark is the one on the call.

items.heading: One fixed fee
items.text: You know the cost before we start, and it only changes if the brief does.

items.heading: Local printers
items.text: Everything we print is made within an hour of the studio.

items.heading: Honest timelines
items.text: We plan around real lead times and tell you early when something slips.
